<!-- pr-reviewer: 5e127955b69e032cfeac51f89d7a434b63b5ef8e -->
Needs changes before merge.

The code removes the parameter holder from the editor preview when a tool body is present. The no-body case keeps the parameter holder. The four new tests check fill, outline, frame size, and the no-body case. No code defect was found.

Local checks against upstream/main cda3d58965843c30c6c70d59c06ac27c4dcda8b0:
- Trial merge: already up to date; no conflicts.
- Gate quick dry-run: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- UI library: 819 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- `boundary`: 3 passed; `boundary_picks`: 6 passed; `sinker_setup`: 2 passed; `theme_files`: 14 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

All checks ran locally. UI tests ran from `crates/ui`. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:923` (PR body evidence): Add before and after screenshots of the tool editor to the PR body. Show the same tool with its body, so the removed holder and the new frame size can be compared. The current body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the PR body. Do not add images to this PR branch.

Notes:
- This change affects editor paint only. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or machining geometry. It is not a safety-tier change. No mutation was run in this review; the author's red/green mutation report was not independently verified.
- No goldens changed. The separate machine-default holder display issue is tracked in #2009.
- `pages.rs` remains above the file-size guideline. The new tests are in a separate file. This is not a blocker.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed the screenshot finding in the latest review.

The PR body now shows before and after renders of the same tool editor and imported body. Before shows the overlapping parameter holder and a 120 mm frame. After shows the replacement body and an 80 mm frame.

The images are stored only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `05173e65caf23e7559f089362140f377c7e63598`. No images or capture harness were added to this PR branch.

The evidence check verifies both immutable image links. Removing either link fails; restoring both passes. Both published PNGs match the captured renders. The four existing `tool_preview_*` pins pass.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is green.

Current head: `5e127955b69e032cfeac51f89d7a434b63b5ef8e`. It is unchanged because the only finding requested PR-body evidence. Plain push reports everything up to date. The PR remains a draft.

Please re-review the screenshot evidence.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

I withdraw the earlier request for changes on this head. The only finding was missing before and after screenshots in the PR body. That finding is now answered.

Both image links work. I inspected both images. They show the same tool dimensions and imported body. Before, the gray parameter holder overlaps the amber body and the frame is 120 mm high. After, the parameter holder is absent and the frame is 80 mm high. The downloaded files match the Git blobs at commit 05173e65caf23e7559f089362140f377c7e63598. That commit is in the fork's pr-screenshots branch history. No images or capture code were added to this PR.

- Trial merge: passed, no conflicts.
- Gate quick dry-run: passed. Its plan includes main's changes because the trial merge is not committed. The tests below cover the PR's UI changes.
- cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run: passed.
- UI library: 819 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed. This includes all four tool_preview tests.
- boundary: 3 passed; boundary_picks: 6 passed; sinker_setup: 2 passed; theme_files: 14 passed.
- cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings: passed.

All build and test commands ran locally in the review worktree. UI tests ran from crates/ui. No GitHub runner was used.

This PR changes editor paint only. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or machining geometry. No safety-tier mutation is required. I did not run mutations; the author's red/green report is not an independent test result. No goldens changed.

Requested before merge: none. No code change is needed to answer the earlier finding.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a new review of the same head after the later Addressed comment. The earlier screenshot finding is resolved. I withdraw the earlier request for changes.

I opened both image links in the PR body and examined the images. They show the same tool and body. Before, the gray parameter holder overlaps the amber body and sets a 120 mm frame. After, the body replaces that holder and sets an 80 mm frame. The image commit contains only `2010/before.png` and `2010/after.png`. The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. No images or capture code are in this PR.

The code keeps the parameter profile when no body is present. The four new tests check fill, outline, frame size, and the case without a body. No code defect was found.
